newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close easier, light trade.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close easier, light trade.

text.p: UK grain futures closed easier after a day of thin trade following hedge selling by physical FOB traders looking to unwind their positions, traders said.
The FOB traders decided to hedge on the futures market because the physical market was unwilling to pay their asking prices, they added.

Wheat futures ended mostly 0.40 to 1.15 stg easier, although July staged a modest late rally to close 0.15 firmer. The most active month November with 299 lots, traded last at 87.90, down 0.50. Total volume was 476 lots.

Barley was much quieter but tracked the trend set by wheat to close 0.25 down. Nov was the only traded position, with 42 lots done. Trade ranged from 84.10 down to 84.00. --Stephen Grainger +44 171 542 8074
